post.summary: Preview an invitation by its token
post.description: Public — no auth required, the same way /auth/reset-password works from a token alone. The token travels in the request body rather than the URL (unlike a typical "preview by ID" GET) so it never ends up written to access logs. Used to render the Accept Invitation page’s context (who invited you, to what wedding, as what role, and via `hasAccount`, whether to prompt for sign-in or account creation) before the visitor has necessarily signed in. Returns the invitation’s current status (including an already-expired/revoked/accepted one) rather than erroring — only a token matching no invitation at all is a 404.

post.description: Requires auth — the caller must already be signed in (or have just registered) with the exact email the invitation was addressed to, or this returns EMAIL_MISMATCH. The token travels in the request body, same reasoning as POST /invitations/preview. Only a PENDING invitation can be accepted — an already-accepted one returns 409 INVITATION_ALREADY_ACCEPTED even if its membership was since removed, so getting back in always needs a fresh invite.
